The '''''Balutar''-class swoop''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by the [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]-based [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] company. Due to its [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] construction, the ''Balutar''-class [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] was often colloquially referred to as a '''Mandalorian speeder bike''' or '''Mandalorian swoop'''. Just over two and a half [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, the ''Balutar''{{'s}} small size belied its powerful [[Engine/Legends|engine]], and featured a low center of [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] that provided an incredible ease of control for its rider.

During the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], made use of a ''Balutar''-class [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] while on Mandalore's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]]. When his investigation of the moon's [[Concordian mines/Legends|abandoned]] [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] led to Kenobi's capture by the rogue Mandalorian splinter-faction known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]—leader of the opposing pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction—utilized a ''Balutar''-class swoop of her own to track down the incarcerated [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|rescue]] him.

==Characteristics==
Constructed by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] company, the ''Balutar''-class [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] was a compact [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]], measuring only 2.66 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length. Despite its small size, the ''Balutar'' possessed an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] more powerful than commonly seen in vessels of its proportions. The swoop's [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] was located at the vehicle's nose, resting above the main airscoop. The ''Balutar''-class swoop's low center of [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] was located directly beneath the seat of the [[Pilot/Legends|driver]], contributing to the significant ease with which an individual could control the vehicle. When manufactured to stock, the ''Balutar'' was without weaponry, however the swoop bike could be outfitted with an additional pair of twin [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], enabling it to perform the task of a small patrol vehicle.<ref name="TCWIV" />

==Role==
A compact [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] with room for a single pilot<ref name="TCWIV" /> and one additional passenger,<ref name="Lawless" /> the ''Balutar''-class swoop served primarily as a means of personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. In addition, the otherwise unarmed swoop could be modified into a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] patrol craft, a role in which it would commonly be augmented with aftermarket twin [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]].<ref name="TCWIV" />

==History==
[[File:BalutarClassSwoop-SWE.png|thumb|left|220px|[[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] riding a ''Balutar''-class swoop]]
The ''Balutar''-class swoop was designed and [[Engineer/Legends|engineered]] by the Mandalorian [[Starship/Legends|starship]] company, MandalMotors<ref name="TCWIV" />—a prominent Mandalorian corporation and driving force behind the economy of Mandalore,<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> headquartered in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>—sometime prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The ''Balutar'' saw use by members of the [[Mandalorian Guard]], who employed the swoop during police operations.<ref name="TBHC" />

By the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], several ''Balutar''-class swoops had come to reside at the [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] of a [[Unidentified Concordia city/Legends|Concordian city]]. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] investigation into the rumored Confederate allegiances of the Mandalorians led him to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] borrowed one of the port's ''Balutar'' swoop bikes to travel to the [[Concordian mines/Legends|mines]]<ref name="TMP" /> thought to have been left abandoned by the Mandalorians when they ceased their search for [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]].<ref name="NewBattlefronts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> There, Kenobi stumbled upon the [[Death Watch hideout|secret base]] of the violent renegade faction of Mandalorians known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. Brutally defeated by a [[Unidentified Death Watch Mandalorian 1|pair]] of [[Unidentified Death Watch Mandalorian 2|Death Watch soldiers]], Kenobi was incarcerated within the [[Mining/Legends|mines]], though he managed to [[Comlink/Legends|contact]] his friend and [[Anti-Mandalore|leader]] of the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. Kryze made use of another of the Concordian starport's ''Balutar''-class speeder bikes in order to track down Kenobi and [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|mount a rescue]].<ref name="TMP" />

The Death Watch owned a number of ''Balutar'' swoops, keeping several at one of their [[Carlac Death Watch camp/Legends|encampments]] on the [[Water/Legends|snowy]] world of [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]]. When [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]]—son of the [[Death/Legends|murdered]] Separatist [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]]—traveled to Carlac to enlist the aid of the Death Watch against his [[Parent/Legends|mother's]] killer, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], several members of the Mandalorian group rode to meet [[Phoenix (GX1 short hauler)/Legends|his ship]] atop ''Balutar''-class speeder bikes, and escorted the [[Gender/Legends|boy]] and his companion, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], back to their camp.<ref name="AFiN" /> Later, the nomadic Death Watch migrated to [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]], a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] and rock-covered moon,<ref name="Zanbar">{{SWE|locations|zanbar|Zanbar}}</ref> taking their ''Balutar'' swoops with them to their newly established [[Zanbar Death Watch camp/Legends|base]] there. During the Death Watch's [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|assault]] on the New Mandalorian capital city of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], Duchess Satine Kryze was [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]], only to be freed by [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|her nephew]] and a contingent of other Mandalorians who had turned against Death Watch's [[Darth Maul/Legends|leadership]]. Escorted by riders on ''Balutar'' swoops, Kryze and the others attempted to flee the bounds of Sundari, but their rescue was thwarted and the duchess recaptured. However, during her escape from the [[Royal prison/Legends|prison]], Kryze had contacted Obi-Wan Kenobi for aid, and the Jedi Master arrived not long after to save her. Breaking the duchess out of [[Prison/Legends|prison]], Kenobi fled with Kryze on a stolen ''Balutar''-class swoop bike to the [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|docks]] of Sundari, only to be intercepted and apprehended again by a team of [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]].<ref name="Lawless" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Balutar''-class airspeeder made its first unnamed appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode, ''[[The Mandalore Plot]]'', which originally aired [[January 29]], [[2010]].<ref name="TMP" /> Further information, including the name of the speeder bike was provided with the release of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' guide book in [[2011]].<ref name="TCWIV" />

The name ''Balutar'' appears to come from the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]] developed by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]], specifically the ''Mando'a'' word ''ba'balut'', an adjective meaning "on patrol," or the similar word ''tabalut'', meaning simply "patrol."<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>

A ''Balutar''-class swoop was included in the 2011 LEGO Mandalorian Battle Pack.<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOCite|num=7914|name=Mandalorian Battle Pack}}</ref>
